title: andropogon virginicus f. hirsutior
intro: Andropogon virginicus f. hirsutior, commonly known as broom sedge or broom beard grass, is a flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial effects, which help in soothing skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of broom sedge include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
